Seasoned frontend engineer focused on delivering performant, accessible web interfaces and component systems using modern React-based stacks.

Collaborated in Agile teams to ship biweekly releases, wrote Tailwind CSS utility patterns and documented usage in Storybook for internal teams. Implemented Next.js page routing and SSR for key flows, improving SEO and initial paint metrics.

Developed sale and policy management interfaces using TypeScript, GraphQL, and React; designed GraphQL schemas and client queries that reduced payload sizes by 25%. Built and maintained Storybook-driven component library for cross-team reuse, increasing consistency across products. Implemented Redux state flows and TypeScript types to catch runtime errors earlier and improve developer velocity. Participated in Agile ceremonies and code reviews to improve quality and delivery cadence.

UI Engineer, Meesho — Sep 2017 - Sep 2018
Contributed to core marketplace UI using React and TypeScript; implemented checkout and product listing components with optimized CSS and Redux state handling. Collaborated with backend on GraphQL endpoints and integrated client-side caching for faster user interactions. Helped migrate legacy styles to modular CSS patterns and assisted in performance tuning for mobile web.
